ai.title: Context-pruner run skip now matches agent name not substring
ai.summary: The agent runtime in `packages/agent-runtime/` now identifies the context-pruner agent for run-tracking skips by exact agent name instead of a substring match. Previously, `agentTemplate.id.includes('context-pruner')` caught any model-calling agent whose id merely contained that name (for example 'context-pruner-test-agent'), minted it an untracked run id, and caused its first LLM call to fail with 'runId Not Found' because the web API refuses untracked ids. The fix calls `parseAgentId` and compares its `agentId` to 'context-pruner', so only the bundled and publisher-qualified pruner ids ('context-pruner', 'codebuff/context-pruner@1.0.0') get the no-op ledger stubs, while every other agent keeps its ledger run. No other files or subsystems are touched.
ai.evidence: The diff in `packages/agent-runtime/src/run-agent-step.ts` changes the context-pruner run-tracking skip from `agentTemplate.id.includes('context-pruner')` to `parseAgentId(agentTemplate.id).agentId === 'context-pruner'`, and adds a test asserting that 'context-pruner-test-agent' retains its ledger run while 'context-pruner' and 'codebuff/context-pruner@1.0.0' skip it.

changes.what: The context-pruner skip in `loopAgentSteps` now matches the parsed agent name exactly rather than a substring, preventing false positives that broke model-calling agents with 'context-pruner' embedded in their id.
A unit test asserts that 'context-pruner' and 'codebuff/context-pruner@1.0.0' produce untracked run ids while 'context-pruner-test-agent' keeps its ledger run.

ai.title: Freebucks timezone header omits unreliable runtime zones
ai.summary: The `freebucksTimeZoneHeaders` function in `common/src/util/freebucks-timezone.ts` now omits the `x-fb-timezone` header instead of sending it when the runtime resolves an unreliable or unknown timezone. This change prevents the server from shifting a user's Freebucks reset schedule to a wrong day, which would cost them a daily refill. A new `freebucksDeviceTimeZone` function evaluates the environment to detect cases where the zone should be suppressed, including when running on a remote host (SSH, Codespaces, dev containers) or when the OS reports a fixed-offset zone on Windows. The header is now omitted rather than defaulting to UTC when the true user zone cannot be determined with confidence.
ai.evidence: The diff in `common/src/util/freebucks-timezone.ts` replaces the simple `freebucksTimeZoneHeaders` implementation with a new `freebucksDeviceTimeZone` function that validates `Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone` against `UTC_ZONES`, `ETC_OFFSET_ZONE`, and `isRemoteHost` checks, and updates the test suite in `common/src/util/__tests__/freebucks-timezone.test.ts` to assert that null is returned when the zone is unknown, a remote host, or a Windows fixed-offset.
ai.unknowns: The diff does not show the server-side logic that consumes the missing header, only that its absence preserves the account's existing schedule.

changes.what: Replaces the unconditional timezone header with a validated device timezone check that omits the header for unknown, remote, or Windows fixed-offset zones.

eli5.text: The application now carefully checks whether it can confidently determine your actual local time before sharing that information with the service. If it is running on a remote computer, inside a container, or if the operating system reports a generic or unreliable time zone, the application leaves out the time detail entirely instead of guessing or defaulting to a standard offset. This protects your free account from having its daily credit refill schedule accidentally shifted to the wrong day, which would prevent you from receiving your expected daily refresh. You do not need to change any settings; the application simply avoids sending incorrect time data that could disrupt your usual free credit cycle.

ai.title: Freebuff CLI 0.2.12 adds Space Bunny Alpha to limited picker
ai.summary: Version 0.2.12 of the Freebuff CLI releases functional updates spanning the model catalog, agent trust boundaries, and ad-serving telemetry. The most significant user-facing change is the inclusion of Space Bunny Alpha in `LIMITED_FREEBUFF_MODEL_IDS`, which exposes this stealth model to limited-access developers in the CLI and Desktop pickers alongside GLM 5.3 Flash and Solar Mini 4. This catalog expansion is paired with a new `FREEBUFF_RETIRED_MODEL_IDS` list that blocks MiniMax M3, GLM 5.2, and Ox Alpha from session admission, directing old clients that still name them to update their binaries. The SDK's remote agent trust gate in `sdk/src/agent-publisher-trust.ts` now rejects untrusted publisher agents that declare `mcpServers`, closing a path where a remote template could spawn local processes or connect to HTTP servers without explicit operator trust.

facts: Publish an already-complete PID atomically. Creating an empty lock and then writing its owner leaves an unrecoverable lock if killed between.

Recover PID locks without allowing two reapers to unlink a successor's lock.

A second filesystem lock would itself survive a crash. A loopback listener is a short-lived, kernel-released reaper mutex on every supported OS. Key it by the observed PID, so aliases of the configuration path share the mutex. Collisions only defer recovery; they never allow concurrent reapers.

ai.title: Add RFC 9562 version 7 UUID generator
ai.summary: A new utility `uuidv7` is added to `common/src/util/uuidv7.ts` to generate RFC 9562 version-7 UUIDs, encoding the current Unix time in milliseconds in the first 48 bits followed by 74 random bits. The implementation uses division instead of bit shifts to handle the 48-bit timestamp, because JavaScript bit shifts truncate to 32 bits. The generated IDs are time-ordered strings that maintain compatibility with existing PostgreSQL `uuid` columns and Zod `.uuid()` validators, which accept UUID versions 1 through 8. This supports primary keys for append-heavy tables like `agent_run`, where chronological ordering improves B-tree page locality compared to random version-4 IDs.
